content.query:
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

CREATE VIEW [EDS].[Currency_Information] AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
            ON FULLDATE <= CRM_DATE
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
WHERE
--- Last n business days
    RN <= Rolling_Window
)
SELECT
RW.FullDate AS AS_OF_DATE,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.STRTEXT10 AS STRTEXT10,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DBFLOAT1 AS DBFLOAT1,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DBFLOAT2 AS DBFLOAT2,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DBFLOAT3 AS DBFLOAT3,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DBFLOAT4 AS DBFLOAT4,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.DTDATE1 AS DTDATE1,
CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.MISCELLANEOUSID AS MISCELLANEOUSID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID AS MISCELLANEOUSINFO_BANK_ID,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY AS MISCELLANEOUSINFO_ORGKEY,
CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.GROUPHOUSEHOLDID AS GROUPHOUSEHOLDID,
CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.BANK_ID AS GROUPHOUSEHOLD_BANK_ID,
CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY AS GROUPHOUSEHOLD_ORGKEY,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.TYPE AS TYPE,
CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ACCOUNTID AS ACCOUNTID
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
    LEFT JOIN eds.Customer_Dim AS CRM_ACCOUNTS
        ON CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
---Fetch all records per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Snapshot' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Delta' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_ACCOUNTS.SCD_Start_Date))
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO AS CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO
        ON CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
        AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.Type = 'EDU_DET'
---Fetch all records that per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Snapshot' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Delta' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.SCD_Start_Date))
        AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.ORGKEY AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO.BANK_ID
    LEFT JOIN eds.CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD AS CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD
        ON CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
        AND SUBSTRING(CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY, 1, 1) = 'R'
---Fetch all records per business day (snapshot)
        AND ((RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Snapshot' AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.SCD_Start_Date AND CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.SCD_End_Date)
            OR (RW.CRM_INTEGRATION_DATA = 'Delta' AND RW.FullDate = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.SCD_Start_Date))
        AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.ORGKEY = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.ORGKEY AND CRM_ACCOUNTS.BANK_ID = CRM_GROUPHOUSEHOLD.BANK_ID;
GO
